name: Farmer's Companion
notes: v1.0.5: Fixed Auto Harvest repeatedly re-harvesting the same already-harvested plant every cycle forever (the game clears a slot's busy flag on harvest but never resets the old Plant object's grown state), which kept showing a false 'Ready to Harvest!' indicator and re-triggering harvest attempts on a dead plant. Note: a harvested plant/tree not auto-replenished by the game will still visually remain until chopped - that part is vanilla Raft behavior, not something the mod overrides.
